sections.Profile:
"Space Train" is a solid-state pinball machine released by Maquinas Automaticas Computerizadas, S.A. (MAC S.A.) in 1987. The game features an outer space fantasy theme, incorporating two flippers, three pop bumpers, two slingshots, four standup targets, and three captive balls.

- Manufacturer: Máquinas Automáticas Computerizadas, S.A.
- Years made: 1987
- In production: no
- Type: Solid State
- Display: Alphanumeric
- Players: 4
- Tags: Space, Original Theme, Solid State, Fantasy, Sci-Fi, 1980s
sections.Editions: - Space Train: released 1987-01-01, MAC System IV
